Container.Name: claude-code
Container.Overview: Claude Code running on your Unraid server as a password-protected browser terminal. Manages other containers via the Docker socket, reads flash config and shares, and can SSH to the host. Build the image locally first (docker build -t claude-code-unraid:latest .). Keep the WebUI on Tailscale/LAN only and set a password.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the ttyd web terminal. Expose over Tailscale/LAN only.

Config.Name: Anthropic API Key
Config.Description: From console.anthropic.com. Leave blank to log in interactively with 'claude' on first run.

Config.Name: Web Terminal Login (user:password)
Config.Description: Login required to reach the web terminal. Format user:password. Set a real password.

Config.Name: Workspace (config + history)
Config.Description: Persists CLAUDE.md, Claude's login/config, and session history.

Config.Name: SSH keys (for host access)
Config.Description: A key here lets Claude 'ssh root@host' for host-level ops. Authorize its .pub on the host. Optional.

Config.Name: Flash config (/boot)
Config.Description: Unraid's USB flash — the only persistent config store. Back it up before changes.

Config.Name: Docker socket
Config.Description: Lets Claude manage other containers with the docker CLI. Grants full control of Docker on the host.
